extracted.intended_audience: Predoctoral fellowship applicants preparing an NIH PHS Fellowship Supplemental Form (e.g., NRSA F31) and their sponsors/collaborators
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and assembling the PHS Fellowship Supplemental Form for an NIH predoctoral (F31/NRSA) fellowship, including required narrative sections (Applicant Background, Specific Aims, Research Strategy), sponsor statements, human/animal subject reporting, and budget/training details. Covers the sections and items applicants must provide and address in the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS Fellowship Supplemental Form — Required Sections (overview)
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists the required sections of the PHS Fellowship Supplemental Form for the fellowship application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sections enumerated on the form include: Introduction (RESUBMISSION); Applicant's Background and Goals for Fellowship Training; Training; Research Training Plan Section; Specific Aims; Research Strategy; Respective Contributions; Selection of Sponsor and Institution; Progress Report Publication List (RENEWAL); Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research; Sponsor(s), Collaborator(s) and Consultant(s) Section; Letters of Support from Collaborators, Contributors and Consultants; Institutional Environment and Commitment to Training; Other Research Training Plan Information; Human Subjects; Vertebrate Animals; Additional Information Section; Budget Section; Appendix. Items marked with * are required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant's Background and Goals for Fellowship Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a narrative describing the applicant's prior research experiences, dissertation narrative, training goals and objectives, and how the fellowship will aid career development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include Doctoral Dissertation and Research Experience, specific training goals (technical and professional skills to be acquired), communication skills development, long-term career goals, and planned activities under award (coursework, mentoring, manuscript preparation, conferences). Use preliminary data and specific examples from past rotations or work to justify preparedness and feasibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training (Training Plan)
rubrics_metrics.description: Detail the training components the applicant will undertake during the award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe coursework, seminars, teaching assistantships, workshops, participation in program activities (e.g., journal clubs, seminars), mentoring responsibilities, and professional development activities (e.g., career seminars, IDP updates). Provide a timeline or table of planned activities and percent effort (e.g., percent research time and distribution among data collection, mentoring, manuscript/thesis prep).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Training Plan Section
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a plan describing how the proposed research will provide appropriate training and skill acquisition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain integrated plans to learn new techniques, support from sponsor and co-sponsor, access to experts, and how the research will broaden technical repertoire. Tie research tasks to training objectives and career trajectory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims
rubrics_metrics.description: Concise statement of the hypothesis and the specific aims of the proposed research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aims should state hypotheses and 1–3 concrete aims that address key questions; for example: Specific Aim 1: Define dsRNA features and context that lead to potent activation of OAS1; Specific Aim 2: Determine molecular mechanism(s) by which different dsRNAs affect OAS1 activity. Describe how complementary assays (in vitro, cell-based, biophysical, structural) will be used to address the aims and the expected impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Strategy (including Significance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the Research Strategy narrative including Significance and how the project addresses important scientific questions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Significance should explain why the problem is important and how the proposed research will advance understanding (e.g., mechanisms of dsRNA regulation of OAS1, host-pathogen interactions). Place the work in the broader context and describe potential implications (e.g., for antiviral therapeutics). Include preliminary data and justification for chosen approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respective Contributions
rubrics_metrics.description: Document the respective contributions of applicant, sponsor, and co-sponsor to the research and training.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear delineation of who will do what (e.g., applicant's role in experiments, mentor responsibilities, shared responsibilities), and evidence that the sponsor/co-sponsor will provide the described training and mentorship.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection of Sponsor and Institution
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain rationale for the choice of sponsor(s) and training environment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe sponsor expertise, co-sponsor contributions, institutional resources, and how the environment is suitable for the applicant's training needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress Report / Publication List (RENEWAL only)
rubrics_metrics.description: For renewals, provide a progress report and list of publications resulting from prior support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize accomplishments, productivity (publications, presentations), and how prior training translated into research progress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe planned instruction in responsible conduct of research (RCR).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detail content, format, frequency, and who will provide RCR training; include documentation that applicant will receive appropriate RCR instruction during the award period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor and Co-Sponsor Statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide statements from sponsor(s) and co-sponsor(s) confirming commitment to training and mentoring.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statements should outline mentoring plans, training opportunities, time commitment, and institutional support; include Co-sponsor roles (e.g., Dr. Lowen as Co-sponsor) and examples of mentor-mentee interactions (e.g., prior collaboration, encouragement to attend meetings).

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of Support from Collaborators, Contributors and Consultants
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach letters documenting collaborator/consultant contributions and support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Letters should specify the nature of the collaboration, resources, access to facilities, and any commitment of time or materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Description of Institutional Environment and Commitment to Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe institutional resources and commitment to the applicant's training.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include description of relevant courses, seminars, program requirements (e.g., BCDB program requirements, student seminars, journal clubs), availability of equipment and core facilities, and institutional support for career development (e.g., IDP requirement, professionalization workshops).

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Subjects — Are Human Subjects Involved?
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether human subjects are involved in the proposed research (Yes/No).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This response is taken from the Research & Related Other Project Information form and repeated for reference. If the answer needs change, it must be edited on the Other Project Information form. Subsequent human subjects questions (involvement indefinite, clinical trial, agency-defined phase III) must be answered and appropriate protections described.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protection of Human Subjects
rubrics_metrics.description: If human subjects are involved, provide protections for human subjects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address human subjects protections, consent, risk minimization, IRB oversight, and any data safety monitoring plans as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data Safety Monitoring Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: If applicable, describe the plan to monitor data safety for human subjects research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include monitoring procedures, roles, and how adverse events will be handled; required especially for clinical trials or higher-risk human subjects research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Women and Minorities
rubrics_metrics.description: Address inclusion (or justified exclusion) of women and minority groups in human subjects research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe plans for recruitment, justifications for any exclusions, and analyses by sex/gender and race/ethnicity where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Children
rubrics_metrics.description: Address inclusion (or justified exclusion) of children (minors) in human subjects research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide rationale and protections if children are included, or justification if excluded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate Animals — Are Vertebrate Animals Used?
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether vertebrate animals are used in the proposed research (Yes/No).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If yes, follow-up items include: Vertebrate Animals Use Indefinite?; Are vertebrate animals euthanized?; If euthanasia is used, specify whether method is consistent with AVMA guidelines and, if not, provide scientific justification and describe method.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate Animals — Euthanasia and AVMA guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: If animals are euthanized, indicate whether methods are consistent with AVMA guidelines or provide justification if not.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the euthanasia method and scientific justification when deviation from AVMA guidelines is proposed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select Agent Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Declare whether the research involves select agents and provide associated information if applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose select agent use and follow agency requirements and biosafety/security plans as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource Sharing Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a plan for sharing research resources generated by the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include data and reagent sharing plans (e.g., resource_sharing_plan_Schwartz.pdf). Describe timelines and mechanisms for sharing and any restrictions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a plan for authentication of critical biological and chemical resources used in the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe how key resources (cell lines, antibodies, biological reagents) will be authenticated and validated, and how contamination or misidentification will be prevented.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Embryonic Stem Cells (HESC)
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the proposed project involves human embryonic stem cells and provide registration numbers or indicate that a registry line will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If HESC are involved, list the registration number(s) of specific cell lines per agency instructions; if a specific line cannot be referenced, check the box indicating one from the registry will be used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Degree Sought During Proposed Award
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the degree the applicant will pursue during the award (e.g., PhD) and expected completion date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide degree type, expected completion month/year, and any other degree-related details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Field of Training for Current Proposal
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the field of training relevant to the proposed research (e.g., Biochemistry).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the numeric or text field as required (e.g., '100 Biochemistry').

rubrics_metrics.name: Current or Prior Kirschstein-NRSA Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose current or prior Kirschstein-NRSA (NRSA) support and provide details (level, type, dates, grant number).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If yes, identify current and prior NRSA support including start/end dates, grant numbers, and whether predoctoral or institutional training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications for Concurrent Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Declare whether the applicant has applied for concurrent support and, if yes, describe in an attached file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide details on other active/pending support and how concurrent awards would be managed if awarded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citizenship / Eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the applicant's citizenship/visa status relevant to eligibility (U.S. Citizen, Non-Citizen National, Permanent Resident, Temporary Visa).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a non-U.S. citizen with temporary visa expects to hold permanent resident status by the earliest start date, check the appropriate box and provide explanation; eligibility rules affect NRSA awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of Sponsoring Institution
rubrics_metrics.description: If changing institution, provide the name of the former institution and relevant details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document prior institution and circumstances of change; provide any necessary approvals or transfer documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Section — Tuition and Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether tuition and fees are requested and provide amounts year-by-year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For fellowship applicants: indicate 'None Requested' or 'Funds Requested' and provide breakdown for each year of the proposed award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Section — Senior Fellowship Applicants: Present Institutional Base Salary
rubrics_metrics.description: For senior fellows only, report present institutional base salary, academic period, and number of months.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide current institutional salary information and months covered; used to justify request levels where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Section — Stipends/Salary During First Year
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the federal stipend requested and any supplementation from other sources (amount and number of months).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Break out federal stipend requested and supplements (type, source, amount, months). For supplements include type (sabbatical, salary, etc.) and source.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix and Supplementary Files
rubrics_metrics.description: Include appendix materials and uploaded PDF documents referenced in form (e.g., Research Strategy PDF, Specific Aims PDF, Sponsor training plan PDF, Resource Sharing Plan PDF).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Label attachments clearly (e.g., Specific_Aims_Schwartz1032089674.pdf) and ensure required documents are uploaded in the correct form sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Activities Planned Under this Award — Time Allocation and Timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a year-by-year plan for research time allocation and planned activities with percent effort for categories like data collection/analysis, mentoring, manuscript/thesis prep, and program activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present a table or schedule showing research vs program activities across grant years and how the percentages for subcategories sum to total research effort (example table provided in narrative).
